title: EFSPI_Events_Calendar
text:
## EFSPI Upcoming Events
{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(readxl)
events <- read_xlsx(“Events.xlsx”) |>
mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
flextable(events) |>
compose(
j = “Agenda Link”,
value = as_paragraph(
hyperlink_text(x = “Agenda”,
url = events[[“Agenda Link”]],
color = “blue”,
underlined = TRUE)
)
) |>
compose(
j = “Registration Link”,
value = as_paragraph(
hyperlink_text(x = “Registration”,
url = events[[“Registration Link”]],
color = “blue”,
underlined = TRUE)
)
)
```
